title: Customer escalation: intermittent metric surface glitch causing zeroed dashboard tiles across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Severity: Multiple enterprise customers reported dashboards showing sporadic zeroed tiles and missing metric series during a 4-hour window across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Symptoms included: metric time series abruptly truncating at the same logical timestamp (tenant watermark), traces missing span links in the same time window, and live panels showing 'no data' despite ingestion pipelines reporting OK. Customers: Acme Retail (hosted), FinEdge (dedicated), and MedSys (private). Objective: perform a targeted RCA, ship an immediate mitigation to restore tenant visibility, and harden ingestion/aggregation logic to prevent recurrence.
reproduction_steps: 1) Use Acme Retail tenant (hosted) and load synthetic traffic that mirrors production burst (5000 tps over 10m with mixed sampling).
2) Query console live panels for 5-minute and 1-hour tiles around the simulated burst; observe zeroed tiles at the watermark boundary for some series.
3) Run span stitcher utility against affected trace windows and note missing parent-child links for ~8% of spans correlated to the same ingestion shard rollover time.
4) Repeat for Dedicated and Private tenants (FinEdge and MedSys) to confirm multi-deployment repro under similar shard rotation conditions.
root_cause_summary: A confluence of factors during parallel telemetry shard rotations: 1) the aggregator periodically rotated shard ownership for scale, 2) an off-by-one watermark update in the timeseries aggregator caused a small window where writes were redirected but read queries used the previous watermark, and 3) the trace index compaction job aggressively evicted recently-written span backpointers due to an incorrect time-to-live calculation when the tenant-level ingest watermark advanced. Result: short-lived holes where metrics were persisted but not served to the console query path, producing zeroed/blank tiles and stitch gaps in traces.
mitigation_actions: Hotfix deployed 2026-03-11 02:10UTC: change reads to fallback to contiguous shard stores when watermark mismatch detected (rollout to hosted first, then dedicated/dedicated-managed, then private).
Emergency throttle applied to aggregator shard rotation frequency to avoid repeated rollover in a short window.
Backfill job submitted to re-index the 4-hour affected window for impacted tenants using durable segment reader (in progress).
follow_up_tasks: Add unit/integration tests for watermark transition path and shard read fallback (ENG-341207-A).
Audit TTL calculations in trace compaction job and fix off-by-one boundary (ENG-341207-B).
Design a canary plan for shard rotation feature with tenant-level opt-outs and telemetry (PM/Eng joint).
Document escalation runbook and add a console livepanel probe for silent-zero tiles to PagerDuty.
